en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historic castle-like building beside a pond with water lilies. The multi‑storey structure has thick stone walls, buttresses along the lower level, and a steep tiled roof pierced by multiple long, narrow dormer openings resembling 'eyelid' windows. Ivy and climbing plants cover parts of the façade. On the right, a tree stands beside an arched gateway in a smaller adjoining building, reached by a narrow bridge with metal railings over the water. A few people are faintly visible near the bridge. The scene has a calm, rural atmosphere.
